newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Pipe files 2.4 mln common shares.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Pipe files 2.4 mln common shares.

text.p: Northwest Pipe Co filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission Tuesday for up to 2.4 million common shares, including 1.2 million shares that certain stockholders may offer.

The company said net proceeds will be used to finance the acquisition and installation of a tubular products production line at its Portland, Ore., facility, repay debt and for general corporate purposes.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters including Hanifen, Imhoff Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 360,000 additional shares.
